title: Core Dashboard & Financial KPI Widgets
description: Build an executive bento dashboard featuring Total Revenue, Pending Receivables, Monthly Expenses, Net Profit Margin, and Cash Flow Trend chart.
acceptanceCriteria: KPI metric cards display accurate formatted currency amounts
Cash flow graph visualizes income vs expenses over time

steps.details: Use Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui Card components to lay out financial KPI metrics.
Render revenue vs expense trends with Recharts or Lucide graphical indicators.
